papers.title_en: Sharper Frames, Worse Rooms: Viewpoint Coverage Dominates Image Quality in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Alibek Dadajonov, Hikmatillo Umarhojiyev
papers.evidence: 研究前馈式多视图三维重建的视角选择策略
papers.tldr: 室内空间推理依赖多视图三维重建，而前馈模型受固定帧数预算约束，选帧方式因此至关重要。论文在九组手持房间扫描中比较图像清晰度与视角覆盖，发现追求最清晰帧会因相机慢速运动而将样本集中在狭窄角度。选最清晰的16帧使房间尺寸误差达48%，均匀时间采样仅为3%；因子实验表明视角覆盖的主效应约为清晰度的三倍，八组扫描中覆盖更广但较模糊的帧表现更好。研究说明小帧数预算下应优先覆盖视角，而现有推理时信号难以识别这一选帧失效。
papers.abstract_en: Grounded spatial reasoning about indoor scenes rests on a geometric reconstruction that the multimodal system does not itself produce. Feed-forward multi-view reconstruction models operate under a fixed view budget, making frame selection a critical upstream decision. We show that under this setting the conventional preference for sharp frames can be actively harmful. Across nine handheld room scans, selecting the sharpest 16 of 200 candidate frames is the worst strategy we test, reaching 48\% room dimension error where uniform temporal sampling reaches 3\%. We trace this failure to a coupling between image quality and camera motion: sharp frames tend to occur during slow motion and therefore concentrate the selection in a narrow angular region, leaving $192^\circ$ of the room unobserved in the case we illustrate and over $300^\circ$ in the worst cells. A $2\times2$ factorial experiment that independently manipulates viewpoint spread and per-frame sharpness shows that spread has roughly three times the main effect of quality, and that blurry but well spread selections outperform sharp but clustered selections in 8 of 9 captures. The advantage also diminishes as the frame budget increases and angular coverage saturates, consistent with this mechanism. Finally, we ask whether the failure is detectable at inference: the reconstruction model's multi-view consistency score increases with reconstruction error, while a vision-language model given the same frames reports confidence unrelated to its own spatial estimation error. Under small view budgets, viewpoint coverage is a more important constraint than per-frame image quality, and neither uncertainty signal available at inference reveals this upstream failure.

papers.title_en: FlowVLA: Enabling World Dynamics Understanding through Pluggable 3D Flow Learning
papers.authors: Junhyeong Go, Mingyu Jung, Woobin Im, Jongbin Ryu
papers.evidence: 学习三维流以理解机器人动作相关的世界动态
papers.tldr: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型主要依赖静态二维图像先验，难以表征物理动作引发的三维世界动态，限制机器人操作鲁棒性。FlowVLA以重建得到的时序三维流作为训练期监督，结合关键点位移预测与末端执行器轨迹对齐，并在推理时移除辅助头。仿真和真实实验显示，该方法提升操作表现、零样本鲁棒性与数据效率。它无需三维传感器或额外推理计算，为二维骨干注入动作相关动态理解。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction enable the extraction of temporally consistent 3D motion from RGB observations; however, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models still predominantly rely on 2D image-text priors. Therefore, they do not accurately represent the fundamental dynamics of the 3D world associated with physical actions. This over-reliance on static 2D visual cues limits the capacity of VLA models in achieving robust robot manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce FlowVLA, a reconstruction-guided, pluggable 3D flow learning framework aimed at empowering VLA models with an inherent understanding of action-relevant dynamics. Instead of requiring explicit 3D sensor inputs or altering the inference-time architecture, our method is designed to utilize temporally aligned 3D flow only during training. This allows the model to learn the dynamic evolution of the physical scene while preserving the computational efficiency of conventional 2D VLA backbones. To bridge scene-level dynamics with robotic manipulation, we propose a modular 3D flow learning framework with dual-level flow supervision. Specifically, point-level flow guides the model to forecast the future displacements of task-critical 3D points, while TCP-level flow aggregates these motions to align with the robot's TCP trajectories. This dual-level flow supervision encourages the model to focus on semantically meaningful dynamic regions, effectively coupling scene-level motion with precise control signals. Extensive evaluations across simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that FlowVLA consistently improves manipulation performance, zero-shot robustness, and optimizes data efficiency. FlowVLA adds only lightweight auxiliary heads during training and discards them at inference. Therefore, FlowVLA introduces no additional 3D sensor inputs, architectural modifications, or inference-time computation.

papers.title_en: Holi-Spatial 360: Generative Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramas for Spatial Rendering and Intelligence
papers.authors: Yuanyuan Gao, Zhirui Liu, Yuning Gong, Yifei Liu, Yifan Zhan, Kuixuan Jiao, Xiaolong Zhou, Yifan Yang, Hongjie Zhang, Xue Yang, Dan Xu, Zhihang Zhong
papers.evidence: 由稀疏全景生成并重建带语义标注的多房间三维场景
papers.tldr: 室内空间智能需要逼真且语义完备的三维环境，但现有数据多为单房间采集，激光雷达成本高；房产平台全景丰富，却因视点稀疏、纹理缺失而难以重建。本文提出 Holi-Spatial 360，以跨视图对应优化约束重建先验，构建三维高斯泼溅空间记忆，并借助图像与视频先验补全外观和连续轨迹。系统生成可渲染、可标注的多房间场景，并结合三维定位与视觉语言模型核验自动整理数据。最终形成逾千个场景、十万余实例标注和两百万空间问答，且提升重建质量及模型空间推理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence requires scalable 3D environments that are both photorealistic and semantically grounded, yet existing indoor datasets are dominated by room-scale captures and costly LiDAR acquisition. Online real-estate platforms offer abundant panoramas of diverse multi-room homes, but sparse viewpoints and texture-poor regions make reconstruction severely under-constrained. We introduce Holi-Spatial 360, a generative reconstruction and data curation framework for converting these panoramas into annotated multi-room 3D environments. Because reconstruction quality bounds subsequent generation, our Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization converts feed-forward reconstruction priors into reliable cross-view constraints and builds a coherent 3D Gaussian Splatting representation as 3D spatial memory. Adapted single-image and video priors then restore appearance and complete continuous trajectories while preserving observed content. The reconstructed scenes support arbitrary RGB-D rendering and an automated curation pipeline that combines end-to-end 3D grounding with VLM-based verification. Holi360 contains over 1K multi-room 3DGS scenes, more than 100K instance annotations, and 2M spatial question-answer pairs. We also introduce the Holi360 benchmark to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in real-world, multi-room indoor environments. Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and curation quality under sparse panoramic inputs, while fine-tuning VLMs on Holi360 substantially improves spatial reasoning capabilities.

papers.title_en: ObjDream: Guiding Vision-Language-Action Models with Object-Level Understanding and Future State Prediction
papers.authors: Huailiang Ma, Yuxuan Li, Ziyi Zhao, Xinkai Wang, Mingyu Li, Xinyu Guo, Lifeng Zhu, Aiguo Song, Cewu Lu, Jianhua Sun
papers.evidence: 视觉语言行动模型进行物体级理解、状态预测与机器人操作
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言动作模型多沿用图像级表征，缺少精细物体理解，因此在物体布局、杂乱程度和背景变化等分布偏移下容易失稳。ObjDream以时空物体槽编码持续身份与动态状态，并将其注入视觉语言模型，通过身份引导路由聚焦相关物体。训练时再用动作条件动力学模块预测未来物体状态，监督动作导致的状态演化，推理时无需未来预测。其在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0及真实机器人实验中提升扰动场景泛化与迁移能力，体现物体中心建模对操作鲁棒性的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling robots to generate actions from visual observations and language instructions. However, most existing VLA models still operate on image-level visual representations inherited from pretrained vision-language backbones, while lacking fine-grained object understanding for manipulation. As a result, their robustness can degrade under out-of-distribution object layouts, clutter, and background variations. To address these limitations, we introduce ObjDream, an object-centric VLA framework centered on object-level understanding and future object state prediction. ObjDream uses a spatio-temporal object encoder to organize visual observations into temporal object slots, where persistent object identity and dynamic object state are represented through separate channels. These structured object representations are inserted into the token sequence of the vision-language model (VLM), where identity-guided routing modulates VLM attention to the corresponding object tokens. In addition, an action-conditioned object dynamics module predicts compact future object states relevant to manipulation during training, explicitly supervising object state evolution under robot actions without requiring future prediction at inference. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 show that ObjDream improves generalization under diverse distribution shifts and scene perturbations. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate that ObjDream transfers to physical manipulation settings with novel object arrangements and background changes.

papers.title_en: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
papers.authors: Chonghan Qin, Dongming Wu, Kaituo Feng, Jiaxu Wang, Xinlei Yu, Peiwen Sun, Yijia Fan, Xilin He, Bingao Chen, Weitong Lian, Ryan Ji, Wenqi Ren, Xiaobin Hu, Dahua Lin, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.evidence: 综述具身机器人系统架构与任务执行
papers.tldr: 基础模型正推动机器人从低层动作预测转向目标导向的智能体系统，使其能够理解指令、规划任务并在真实执行中纠错与调整策略。然而，相关研究发展迅速却相互割裂，尚缺少整合不同智能体功能的系统视角。本文梳理机器人策略向智能体系统的演进，覆盖视觉语言动作模型、世界模型和世界动作模型，并将研究归纳为模型、数据、环境与支架四个领域、十七个类别。综述进一步分析各领域对学习、数据构建、任务评测和机器人使用的作用，讨论开放挑战与未来方向，为构建更可靠、适应性更强的机器人提供统一参照。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

papers.title_en: TS-WAM: Temporal Latent Actions and World-Action Coupling for Vision-Language Robot Control
papers.authors: Menghao Yin, Jiaju Yin, Xiyue Dong, Lixin Xu, Zhenhui Zhang, Ke Zhang, Yating Feng, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: 具身机器人控制中的世界状态预测与动作耦合
papers.tldr: 许多视觉语言动作策略依赖带动作标注的机器人示范，难以利用无动作视频，也缺少对未来视觉状态的显式预测，因而易受示范条件限制，泛化与鲁棒性不足。TS-WAM提出轻量级师生世界—动作模型，通过自监督时间学习结合机器人示范和人类视频，并联合预测潜在动作与未来视觉特征来引导控制。其端到端训练无需外部教师，也不需单独预训练潜在动作或世界模型，推理时移除教师分支以降低部署负担。在多个仿真基准及Franka Research 3、RevoTron真实操作实验中，模型展现出较强的操作表现、泛化能力与鲁棒性，体现了融合视频学习和未来预测的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Many vision-language-action policies rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations and lack an explicit mechanism for predicting future visual states. These limitations hinder learning from action-free videos and can encourage overfitting to demonstration conditions, weakening generalization and robustness. We present TS-WAM, a lightweight Teacher-Student World-Action Model that addresses these challenges through self-supervised temporal learning and explicit future prediction. Its vlm-jepa framework learns from heterogeneous data, including robot demonstrations and action-free human videos, using an EMA target branch without requiring a separately trained external teacher. By coupling vlm-jepa with delta-lwm, TS-WAM learns to predict latent actions from the current observation and instruction and uses them to predict future visual features that guide action generation at inference. A unified end-to-end training architecture jointly optimizes temporal representation learning, visual dynamics, and robot control without a separate latent-action or world-model pretraining stage. The EMA target branch is removed at inference, keeping the deployed policy lightweight. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv, together with real-world manipulation experiments on Franka Research 3 and RevoTron, demonstrate that TS-WAM achieves strong manipulation performance, generalization, and robustness.

papers.title_en: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhixu Li, Keqian Tang, Litian Gong, Jingyu Yao, Wenqian Zhang, Tianze Xu, Zehao Wang, Yuping Wang, Junge Zhang, Jiachen Li
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能体的个性化机器人操作基准
papers.tldr: 家庭通用机器人不仅要完成操作任务，还需符合用户偏好，但个性化操作缺少能区分任务成功与偏好满足的受控基准。LIBERO-PeRM基于LIBERO构建偏好学习评测，涵盖运动方式、操作技能和用户画像选择，并提供五类任务套件、312项任务及成对示范与自动指标。实验发现，现有视觉语言动作策略零样本个性化较弱，监督微调可学会偏好；混合训练更能保留无偏好能力，但会削弱部分运动偏好学习。该基准进一步揭示跨布局与任务泛化、偏好组合及冲突处理的难点，为具身个性化研究提供可复用评测资源。
papers.abstract_en: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Learning Dynamic Grasping
papers.authors: Nga Kiu Kelly Ho, Yilin Liu, Hao Xu, Niloy J. Mitra
papers.evidence: 从初始手物状态生成完整抓取和操作动作
papers.tldr: 可信的手物抓取动画需要连贯呈现手部接近、接触及抬起或操作，但既有方法多只生成静态抓取，或依赖语言、目标抓取和物体轨迹等额外条件。本文从单一初始手物状态出发，采用条件流匹配预测全序列接触图与手姿，再以免训练的接触引导加权配准恢复刚体物体运动。在留出物体和野外重建几何上，生成动作更平滑，野外接触与穿透指标持平或更优，逐帧速度约快30倍，用户在约三分之二的比较中更偏好本文结果。研究展示了从稀疏初态生成完整抓取动作的潜力，同时指出新几何上的精确接触闭合仍是关键挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing believable 4D hand-object grasping sequences is important for character animation, extended reality, and embodied agents. Grasping requires a hand to approach, contact, and lift or manipulate an object coherently. Existing synthesis methods often model only the final static grasp or rely on additional conditions, such as language, target grasps, or object trajectories, to specify the interaction. We instead study the underconstrained problem of generating a complete grasping motion from a single initial hand-object state. Our framework decouples hand-motion generation from object-motion recovery. Given an object point cloud in the initial wrist frame and the initial parameterized hand configuration, conditional flow matching predicts a sequence-level contact map and a hand pose at each normalized sequence time. This time-indexed formulation avoids the error accumulation of autoregressive rollout while representing the complete motion. We then infer an attachment frame and recover rigid-object motion through training-free, contact-guided weighted registration. We evaluate on held-out DexYCB objects and unseen object geometries reconstructed from in-the-wild videos by Open-CHOIR. Compared with LatentHOI, our method produces smoother hand and object motion in every setting, matches or improves on its contact and penetration metrics in the wild under a shared initialization, and is about 30x faster per generated frame. In a 15-participant study, our motions were preferred in roughly two thirds of (forced-choice pairwise) comparisons. Precise contact closure on novel geometry, however, remains a key open challenge.

papers.title_en: All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking
papers.authors: Yewon Kim, Paul Hongsuck Seo, Sang Chul Ahn
papers.evidence: 将DUSt3R几何预测用于动态场景SLAM
papers.tldr: 动态场景中的运动物体会干扰定位与建图，现有动态 SLAM 方法还存在过度移除静态可用区域、计算成本高等问题。本文提出仅依赖 RGB 的实时动态 SLAM 框架，不使用预设类别标签或分割模型。方法结合 DUSt3R 根据自运动预测的像素运动与 All-Tracker 的点跟踪，通过比较两者逐像素识别并移除实际运动区域，物体暂时静止的部分仍可用于跟踪。系统约以每秒 10 帧运行，通过每三帧取样处理 30 帧视频，显著快于既有稠密动态 SLAM 方法。
papers.abstract_en: SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a core technology in autonomous systems that enables them to estimate their own position and build a map of unknown environments simultaneously. SLAM systems in dynamic environments are of great practical importance. However, existing dynamic SLAM approaches still have several limitations like over-removal and high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM framework that precisely removes moving objects at the pixel level without relying on predefined labels or segmentation models. Our system combines pixel motion predicted by ego-motion using DUSt3R with point tracking from All-Tracker, removing only actually moving pixels by analyzing discrepancies between the two motion sources. Unlike object-level masking methods, our approach eliminates only currently moving regions, allowing temporarily static parts to be utilized for tracking. Operating at approximately 10 FPS, the system achieves real-time performance on standard 30 FPS video streams by subsampling every 3 frames. Relying solely on RGB inputs, this significantly improves upon state-of-the-art dense dynamic SLAM approaches (0.5-3 FPS), presenting a highly practical solution.

papers.title_en: CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation
papers.authors: Han Liang, Sibo Wu, Anpei Chen, Rüdiger Westermann
papers.evidence: 从无位姿多视图图像学习可渲染三维场景表示
papers.tldr: 无位姿多视图图像包含场景几何与外观信息，但直接表示可能冗余，紧凑压缩又容易损失重建所需内容。CoTL将图像编码为跨视角融合的少量潜在令牌，并以新视角渲染监督端到端训练。解码器通过场景无关查询从令牌中恢复可渲染的三维高斯，新增视角只需增加少量、与分辨率无关的令牌。在 RealEstate10K 与 ACID 上，方法取得有竞争力的新视角合成效果，令牌空间也可作为三维高斯场景生成模型的潜表示，展示了紧凑场景学习的价值。
papers.abstract_en: We present CoTL, a framework that learns a compact set of tokens that preserves scene geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images. Our encoder compresses the input images into small per-view sets of latent tokens that aggregate information across views to form a view-consistent scene representation. Each additional view expands the representation with only a small, resolution-independent set of tokens, allowing its capacity to grow with the available observations. To force this compact bottleneck to retain sufficient scene information, a query-based Gaussian decoder uses scene-independent queries to attend to the learned tokens and recover an explicit, renderable set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Novel-view rendering supervision trains the compact representation end to end through the reconstructed Gaussian scene. Experiments on RealEstate10K and ACID show that the resulting compact, unstructured token set supports competitive novel-view synthesis and can serve as the latent space of a generative model for 3D Gaussian scene generation. Together, these results show that 3D Gaussian reconstruction is an effective objective for compact scene representation learning and the learned token space provides a basis for broader downstream tasks in 3D vision.

papers.title_en: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
papers.authors: Qiang He, Yonghao Zhang, Yinda Zhang, Chenyu Meng, Liufei Ouyang, Haoxiang Hu, Cangjun Gao, Xiaoming Deng, Cuixia Ma, Hongan Wang
papers.evidence: 生成包含身体、手部、物体轨迹及接触的人物交互
papers.tldr: 全身人—物交互生成需要同步协调身体与手指动作、物体轨迹及随时间变化的接触关系，而迭代扩散和测试时优化通常推理成本较高。MFlowHOI以接触感知的多部件残差量化变分自编码器组织身体、手部、物体和接触信号，并通过共享解码器保持整体协调；时空扩散变换器在潜空间中建模时序与部件依赖，单次均值流评估即可生成完整交互。预测的物体局部接触对应关系还可用于几何细化，并将交互迁移至不同体型的写实三维高斯化身。实验表明其动作质量和文本对齐优于既有基础生成器，且推理时间大幅降低。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

papers.title_en: DeTac: Dual-branch Decoupling of Texture and Force Signals in Vision-Based Tactile Sensors
papers.authors: Zhirui Zhang, Yunkai Tang, Jiahang Li, Fan Fei, Jinnuo Zhang, Kairan Ding, Jieji Ren, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi
papers.evidence: 面向灵巧机器人操作的视觉触觉感知
papers.tldr: 视觉触觉传感器能支持灵巧操作，但单幅观测中的表面纹理与接触力信号彼此耦合，难以可靠分离。既有串行掩膜修复受压痕影响，存在掩膜尺寸难定与误差累积问题，也缺少真实配对数据监督。DeTac提出双分支生成框架，从混合图像并行生成阴影图和标记图，以全图合成摆脱掩膜依赖，并借跨分支协同优化实现相互监督。实验表明该方法解耦精度达到先进水平，改善表面重建和力估计且可跨传感器泛化，为视觉触觉感知提供更可靠的信号分离方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based tactile sensors enable fine-grained perception for dexterous robotic manipulation, but current marker-based designs tightly couple surface texture and contact force signals within a single observation. Existing data-driven decoupling methods rely on serial mask-based inpainting, which suffers from mask-sizing dilemmas caused by physical indentation effects, error retention, and lack of real paired data for supervision. To address these challenges, we propose DeTac, a novel dual-branch generative framework that concurrently extracts clean shading and marker images from a single mixed tactile image. DeTac leverages full-image synthesis to naturally bypass mask dependency and introduces a cross-branch synergistic optimization that enables mutual supervision, effectively preventing error retention. Furthermore, we construct a strictly aligned, real-world paired tactile dataset using custom hardware to provide high-quality supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeTac achieves state-of-the-art decoupling accuracy, significantly facilitating downstream surface reconstruction and force estimation tasks while exhibiting cross-sensor generalization.

papers.title_en: Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Scene Reconstruction: Methods, Systems, and Trade-offs
papers.authors: Ashim Dahal, Rabab Abdelfattah, Nick Rahimi
papers.evidence: 综述高斯泼溅场景重建方法与系统
papers.tldr: 3D高斯泼溅自2023年兴起，凭借显式、可配置的场景表示实现高质量实时新视角合成，但实时渲染不等于实时建图、更新与维护。本文将场景重建归纳为单次生成、动态表示、效率与压缩、流式沉浸系统及高斯泼溅同步定位与建图五类。综述区分渲染吞吐与生成、更新、跟踪、优化等任务成本，并结合稀疏视角基准和原生评测比较质量、延迟、内存及更新代价。由此连接各类方法与工具至端到端流程，呈现不同应用路线的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis. Since its inception in 2023, its explicit and highly configurable scene representation has been extended toward sparse-view generation, dynamic reconstruction, efficiency and compression, streaming, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Although Gaussian Splatting can provide real-time rendering, rendering an existing representation is distinct from constructing, updating, or maintaining the scene itself. In this survey, we synthesize current literature, categorize them and provide a connection of current approaches and tools towards an end-to-end pipeline. Explicitly, we categorize GS scene reconstruction into five overlapping families: single-shot generation, dynamic representations, efficiency and compression, streaming and immersive systems, and Gaussian Splatting SLAM. We distinguish render-only throughput from task-specific scene generation, update, tracking, mapping, and optimization costs, and combine controlled sparse-view benchmarking with native evaluations to identify cross-family quality, latency, memory, and update-cost trade-offs.

papers.title_en: HelpMeOut: A Neuropsychology-Grounded Benchmark for Error-Aware Monitoring of Household Task Execution
papers.authors: Haoran Wang, Jingwei Huang, Anqing Duan, Ho Seok Ahn, Bruce Macdonald
papers.evidence: 具身智能基准评估持续观察与任务执行错误诊断
papers.tldr: 现有具身家庭任务基准通常假设人能正确执行活动，却难以覆盖认知障碍者和老年人日常生活中的结构化错误。论文提出HelpMeOut，要求智能体观察持续的人类活动轨迹，尽早判断任务是否出错并诊断错误类型。基准整理两万组配对活动片段，涵盖九类受神经心理学研究启发的错误，并评测多种监控方法。实验显示这些方法普遍表现不佳，常漏掉执行偏差；该基准由此填补了目标推断与任务完成评测的空白，支持错误感知型辅助智能体研究。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HelpMeOut, an embodied AI benchmark for error-aware monitoring of household task execution. Existing embodied household benchmarks typically assume that humans execute tasks correctly, but this assumption does not hold for cognitively impaired persons or older adults whose everyday activities produce structured execution errors. To address this gap, HelpMeOut operationalizes research on everyday action errors into 20000 paired activity episodes, covering nine neuropsychologically motivated error categories. In each episode, agents observe a streaming human activity trajectory and must monitor whether the execution is unfolding correctly, diagnosing any structured errors as early as possible. We evaluate learned-monitor, symbolic, change-point, and frontier LLM prompting baselines. Results show that these methods perform poorly as error monitors, often missing when execution goes wrong. These results suggest a gap left by standard goal-inference and task-completion benchmarks, making HelpMeOut a testbed for error-aware assistive agents.

papers.title_en: Perception Beyond the Visible: Incompleteness-Aware Scene Understanding for Robot Autonomy
papers.authors: Rohit Mohan
papers.evidence: 研究机器人对遮挡及不完整观测环境的场景理解
papers.tldr: 机器人在遮挡、未知物体和传感器退化下只能获得局部且含噪的观测，现有系统却常假设场景可见、类别固定且测量可靠。论文提出面向不完整性的场景理解研究愿景，涵盖模态感知、语义占据预测、开放世界理解、标签高效学习及不确定性引导的多模态融合。研究将问题归纳为证据、知识和传感器可靠性三类不完整，并提出面向未来的信念中心四维场景表征，联合描述几何、语义、运动与不确定性。进一步结合主动感知和安全适应，让机器人通过交互降低不确定性，目标是形成经过校准、可用于行动的表征，支撑动态开放环境中的可靠自主。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.

papers.title_en: WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention
papers.authors: Mijeong Kim, Kyujin Lim, Bohyung Han
papers.evidence: 共享世界坐标的多视图Transformer注意力与深度假设建模
papers.tldr: 多视图图像中的同一三维点在各视角具有不同像素坐标，传统二维旋转位置编码难以建立可靠的跨视角对应，深度不确定性还会干扰注意力。WorldRoPE 在共享世界坐标系中，将每个图像块表示为多个带协方差的体积高斯原语，并把键 token 的支持投影到查询视角。它以闭式形式对投影位置分布上的旋转算子求期望，结合混合权重与协方差衰减，无需栅格化或变形特征。实验显示其在新视角合成、深度估计和三维几何重建上有效，为多视图 Transformer 提供不确定性感知的几何引导注意力。
papers.abstract_en: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used to encode relative positions in Transformers. In multi-view settings, however, patch coordinates are defined independently in each image: the same 3D point can therefore have different coordinates across views, making them insufficient for establishing cross-view correspondences. We introduce WorldRoPE, a probabilistic world-centric RoPE for multi-view attention. At each layer, WorldRoPE back-projects each patch token into a set of volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame. These primitives represent multiple plausible 3D supports for a token, jointly capturing alternative depth hypotheses, depth uncertainty, and the finite spatial extent of its patch frustum. When a key token's support is projected into a query view, it induces a distribution over where that key may appear in the query image. WorldRoPE integrates the rotary operator over this distribution in closed form, combining rotations at the projected primitive centers according to their mixture weights with covariance-dependent attenuation. This makes attention less sensitive to uncertain key locations in the query view, without rasterizing or warping token features. The formulation reduces to deterministic RoPE when the support collapses to a point. Across layers, the predicted geometry guides cross-view attention, while the updated features refine the geometry used at the next layer. Experiments on novel view synthesis, depth estimation, and 3D geometry reconstruction demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRoPE for multi-view Transformers.

papers.title_en: Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View Planning for Highly Occluded Target Perception
papers.authors: Ayse Gul Yildiz, Rekha Raja
papers.evidence: 机器人主动感知规划视点，逐步揭示被遮挡目标区域
papers.tldr: 严重遮挡会使机器人单一视角只能获取目标局部信息，逐步补全目标表面时，传统贪心式下一最佳视点规划容易错过“先铺垫、后观测”的视角序列。论文将局部目标感知建模为短时域序列规划，提出滚动时域下一最佳视点方法，评估候选未来视点序列而非孤立视点。仿真与UR5e实机实验涵盖受控遮挡的马克杯、兔子，以及自然自遮挡的番茄植株；最严重遮挡的马克杯场景中，区域覆盖率达63.8%，遮挡表面召回率达85.5%，显著优于单步基线。消融表明收益来自多步推理而非额外计算；该方法尤其适用于高度遮挡目标，遮挡较轻时，较便宜的单步方法仍具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic systems that must acquire information about a specific target often face severe occlusion from sur- rounding structures or from the target itself, such that a single camera viewpoint provides only partial information. Active perception must therefore select viewpoints that progressively reveal unobserved regions. However, conventional local next- best-view (NBV) methods typically select viewpoints according to their immediate utility, which can overlook views that provide limited information initially but enable more informative obser- vations from subsequent viewpoints. We formulated local target perception as a short-horizon sequential view-planning problem and proposed a Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View (RH-NBV) planner that evaluates candidate sequences of future viewpoints rather than isolated views. RH-NBV is evaluated on a UR5e manipulator with an eye-in-hand RGB-D camera in simulation as well as on physical robot against a gradient-based NBV planner, and random search, using a coffee mug and Stanford bunny under controlled occlusion and a tomato plant with natural self-occlusion. Under heavy occlusion, RH-NBV achieves substantially higher target information recovery, reaching 63.8% ROI coverage versus 34.2% and 85.5% occluded-surface recall versus 7.4% for the single-step NBV baselines on the most occluded mug configuration. A controlled horizon ablation shows that this improvement arises from multi-step reasoning rather than additional computation. RH-NBV provides the greatest benefit for strongly occluded targets, while myopic NBV remains competitive and substantially cheaper when visibility is less constrained.

papers.title_en: SceneAE: Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Queryable 3D-Anchored Latent Space
papers.authors: Shuofeng Sun, Wenzhao Zheng, Yunpeng Zhang, Yi Wu, Linqing Zhao, Haibin Yan
papers.evidence: 利用空间锚定潜变量进行三维场景表示与重建
papers.tldr: 视频世界模型借助三维记忆保存历史观测，也引出一个问题：三维表示能否直接成为重建与生成场景的潜空间？SceneAE将场景编码为稀疏三维锚定潜在点云，每个潜变量兼具显式位置与隐式内容。重建时，同一持久表示可解码为不同相机的彩色与深度观测；生成时先构造可控几何，再合成条件化内容。实验显示其生成质量、计算成本与相机可控性更优，推动潜空间从视角外观描述转向场景本身。
papers.abstract_en: Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an   explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a   sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our   representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For   reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory.   For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and   then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera   controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.

papers.title_en: Object Pose from 2-D to 3-D Point and Line Correspondences
papers.authors: Thai Quynh Phong, Radu Horaud, Adnan Yassine, Pham Dinh Tao
papers.evidence: 利用二维至三维点线对应关系估计相机与物体的旋转和平移
papers.tldr: 从二维图像的点和线对应关系估计相机与三维物体间的旋转和平移，是物体位姿求解的关键问题。论文提出一种统一处理点、线或两者组合的估计方法，并通过设计误差函数刻画对应关系。方法使用双数四元数表示旋转与平移，使误差函数具有二次形式，再以信赖域优化求解。实验显示，该方法与牛顿法、Faugeras-Toscani线性标定法及Levenberg-Marquardt法相比具有竞争力，并对图像噪声和匹配错误表现出稳健性。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we present a method for optimally estimating the rotation and translation between a camera and a 3-D object from point and/or line correspondences. First we devise an error function and second we show how to minimize this error function. The quadratic nature of this function is made possible by representing rotation and translation with a dual number quaternion. We provide a detailed account of the computational aspects of a trust-region optimization method. This method compares favourably with Newton's method which has extensively been used to solve the problem at hand, with Faugeras-Toscani linear method [6] for calibrating a camera, and with the Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear optimization method. Finally we present some experimental results which demonstrate the robustness of our method with respect to image noise and matching errors.

papers.title_en: GLoD-LVSM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Continuous-LoD Scene Representations for Large View Synthesis Models
papers.authors: Weikai Lin, Nicholas Milef, Carl S Marshall, Grant Kaijuin Yang, Todd Keeler, Yuhao Zhu
papers.evidence: 学习几何引导的连续细节层级场景表示
papers.tldr: 大型视角合成模型可由稀疏视图快速重建并渲染新视角，但场景令牌冗余带来存储与渲染开销，固定规模表示也难按预算调整。GLoD-LVSM以连续场初始化可变数量锚点，并通过端到端凝聚器聚合场景信息，利用参考令牌与锚点几何引导压缩及解码剔除。相较未压缩模型，它在无质量损失时令牌减少33.4%、渲染加速1.23倍；允许一定质量损失时减少85.5%、加速3倍。模型还涌现出与表面对齐、随纹理复杂度自适应分布的锚点和场景深度，并可支持语义理解。
papers.abstract_en: Large view synthesis models (LVSMs) reconstruct scenes from sparse views and render novel views quickly, but they incur unnecessary storage and rendering costs due to token redundancy. We present GLoD-LVSM, a compact, geometry-grounded scene representation for LVSMs with continuous levels of detail. First, instead of learning a fixed set of scene anchor initializations, GLoD-LVSM learns a continuous field that initializes a flexible number of anchors to match the desired budget. A condenser then aggregates scene information into these anchors, with both the field and condenser trained end-to-end. Second, the condenser infers reference-token and anchor geometry to guide compression through geometry-grounded attention, improving rendering quality and enabling frustum culling during decoding. Compared with existing LVSM scene-compression baselines, GLoD-LVSM achieves the best trade-off between rendering quality and scene token count. Compared with the uncompressed base model, GLoD-LVSM reduces the scene-token count by 33.4% and accelerates rendering by $1.23\times$ with no quality loss. Under a relaxed quality-loss budget, the reduction increases to 85.5%, with $3.00\times$ rendering speedup. Further analysis reveals that view-synthesis supervision yields emergent scene depth and self-organized anchors that align with surfaces and adapt their density to local texture complexity. Beyond rendering, we further show that our scene representation also supports scene-semantic understanding, highlighting its potential for broader downstream tasks.

papers.title_en: Region Aware Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks for Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Jack Roberts, Praneeth Tummala, Kavi Sarna, Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto
papers.evidence: 区域感知模块可辅助图像分割
papers.tldr: 挤压激励通过全局平均池化建模通道依赖，却会抹去空间结构，因而不易满足图像分割的密集预测需求。论文以空间引导池化替代全局池化，提出四种区域感知模块，覆盖规则网格、超像素、语义区域和端到端学习的软分配。实验涉及三项二值分割、两项语义分割及迷你图像网分类任务，方法在多数基准上超过挤压激励及相关注意力变体。该设计兼顾计算成本与区域适应性，软分配还可直接提供结构化空间解释。
papers.abstract_en: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules improve convolutional networks by modeling channel-wise dependencies, but global average pooling collapses spatial structure into a single per-channel descriptor, limiting their effectiveness for dense prediction tasks such as image segmentation. We generalize SE by replacing global pooling with spatially guided pooling, enabling region-aware channel recalibration through four modules with complementary cost profiles. BASE formalizes Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite using a regular grid; SPASE pools over SLIC superpixels for image-adaptive regions; MAPSE obtains regions from semantic maps produced by a frozen, general-purpose network; and PLEASE learns soft region assignments end-to-end through a lightweight assignment network. Each channel receives one gate per region, so attention at each pixel reflects its region membership, bridging channel and spatial attention. PLEASE also produces its soft assignments as a byproduct of the forward pass, providing structured spatial interpretability without post-hoc analysis. The modules offer complementary computational tradeoffs: some add essentially no parameters, while others add no measurable latency. Across binary segmentation on CUB, DUTS, and ECSSD, semantic segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, and classification on mini-ImageNet, our modules outperform SE and related spatial-channel attention variants on most benchmarks, achieving the majority of best results.

papers.title_en: VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation
papers.authors: Chaofan Gan, Yian Zhao, Shijie Li, Tieyuan Chen, Zicheng Zhao, Mehrtash Harandi, Weiyao Lin
papers.evidence: 将三维几何约束融入视频重建式自编码器
papers.tldr: 视频自编码器负责将高维视频压缩为生成模型使用的潜在表示，但现有方法主要优化像素重建，几何结构监督有限。VGGA将视频视为动态三维世界的二维投影，通过结构深度、运动对应和投影变形约束潜在表示，并由共享时空解码器联合学习几何信息与RGB重建。在RealEstate10K和Taichi-HD上，gFVD分别降低28.1%和37.7%，重建质量仍与基线相当。结果说明，几何约束能提升潜在空间对视频生成的适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Autoencoders are the core component of latent video generative models, compressing high-dimensional videos into compact latent spaces for downstream generation. However, existing video autoencoders are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, providing limited supervision for learning structured latent representations. We argue that videos should not be treated merely as signals to be reconstructed, but rather as 2D projections of dynamic 3D worlds that exhibit explicit and well-structured geometric properties. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{G}eometry \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{A}utoencoder (\textbf{VGGA}), a geometry-aware video autoencoder that explicitly incorporates geometric constraints into the reconstruction process. Specifically, VGGA grounds the learned representations along three complementary geometric dimensions: \emph{Structural Depth}, \emph{Motion Correspondence}, and \emph{Projective Warping}. These objectives are unified within a Video Geometry Decoder, which employs a shared spatio-temporal upsampling trunk to jointly optimize geometric learning and RGB reconstruction. Through these geometry-grounded objectives, VGGA encourages the latent representations to capture the underlying 3D structure and motion of dynamic scenes. VGGA consistently improves video generation across both geometry-centric and human-motion domains, reducing gFVD by 28.1\% on RealEstate10K and 37.7\% on Taichi-HD. Notably, these substantial generation improvements are achieved while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, demonstrating that geometry-grounded representation learning yields a more effective latent space for video generation.

papers.title_en: Learning Incompressible 3D Flows from Sparse Samples: A Set Transformer Approach to Divergence-Free Kernel Fitting
papers.authors: Ramzi Idoughi, Radouan Boukharfane, Peter Wonka
papers.evidence: 集合Transformer从稀疏三维样本重建连续场表示
papers.tldr: 从稀疏、含噪或遮挡的三维观测恢复不可压缩速度场，既要应对信息不足，也要保证物理一致性。DFK-Former以集合Transformer处理无序输入，直接预测散度自由核参数，并用自适应、各向异性核表达复杂流动，构造上严格满足无散度约束。实验覆盖不同稀疏度、噪声与遮挡，并迁移至真实DNS湍流数据；相较逐场核优化，端点误差最高降低4.6倍，耗时从9.8秒降至7.5毫秒。该方法以一次前向推理替代迭代拟合，为快速、连续且物理一致的流场重建提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering divergence-free velocity fields from sparse and corrupted observations requires reconciling physical consistency, expressive representations, and robustness to missing data. We introduce DFK-Former, a set-to-field transformer that reconstructs divergence-free velocity fields from sparse, noisy, and irregularly sampled 3D observations. The model is inherently invariant to the number and ordering of input samples and predicts the parameters of a divergence-free kernel representation, producing continuous, mesh-free velocity fields that satisfy incompressibility exactly by construction rather than approximately through soft constraints or projection operators. Unlike existing divergence-free kernel approaches, which estimate kernel coefficients via a separate optimization for each field, DFK-Former predicts these coefficients directly in a single forward pass. This eliminates costly iterative fitting while providing a learned prior that enables accurate reconstruction even when observations are insufficient to uniquely determine the field. To enhance representational power, we introduce adaptive and anisotropic divergence-free kernels that preserve exact incompressibility guarantees while capturing more complex flow structures. Extensive experiments across varying levels of sparsity, noise, and occlusion, including transfer to real Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) turbulence data, demonstrate substantial gains in both accuracy and efficiency. DFK-Former reduces endpoint error by up to 4.6x compared to per-field divergence-free-kernel optimization, while reconstructing each field in 7.5 ms instead of 9.8 s, yielding a speedup of more than three orders of magnitude. These results establish direct, feed-forward prediction of divergence-free kernel parameters as a practical and effective paradigm for physically consistent velocity-field reconstruction from sparse observations.

papers.title_en: A Differentiable 3D Scene Graph Metric via Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry
papers.authors: U-Chae Jun, Yoonhyuk Choi, Jiwoo Kang
papers.evidence: 以图级度量监督三维场景语义与关系结构
papers.tldr: 现有三维场景图预测多用对象与谓词的逐项分类损失，难以衡量整图语义与结构差异，也未把主语—谓词—宾语事实作为整体比较。本文提出上下文海灵格三元组几何，将分类器输出解释为对齐的概率场景图，并以可微的图级目标监督预测。该方法可因式分解高效计算，无需改动现有网络；在3DSSG上改善图条件三维场景生成，用户评价也显示描述性、关系合理性和结构保留更优。研究提供了更贴近场景图整体质量的训练监督。
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly supervised with local object and predicate classification losses. Although effective for slot-wise label prediction, this formulation does not provide a graph-level semantic distance between a predicted scene graph and its ground truth: semantically mild label errors and structurally disruptive relational errors can be treated similarly, and subject-predicate-object facts are not compared as scene-level units. We propose Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry, a graph-level supervision objective that measures the semantic and structural discrepancy between 3D scene graphs. Our key idea is to reinterpret the conventional classifier outputs of a 3D scene graph predictor as an aligned probabilistic scene graph field, where object and predicate predictions jointly define contextual subject-predicate-object facts. This formulation yields a differentiable metric-based training objective with an efficient factorized implementation and can be applied to existing 3D scene graph prediction architectures without modifying their network design. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate that our supervision improves downstream graph-conditioned 3D scene generation, while ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of the proposed graph-level terms and user studies show better graph descriptiveness, relation plausibility, and structural preservation.

papers.title_en: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
papers.authors: Yu Wang, Rui Dai, Wei Chen, Yi Wang, Bo Dang, Kaikui Liu, Xiangxiang Chu, Yansheng Li
papers.evidence: 智能体在交互式三维场景中主动搜索并定位目标
papers.tldr: 城市级三维指代定位通常通过对预生成实例候选排序实现，但大规模户外场景中的候选构建与遍历效率不高。Urbex 将定位改写为主动空间搜索，把三维城市表示为可交互的多视角环境，由视觉语言模型智能体查询地标、缩放局部区域、切换斜视视角并提交边界框，再用强化学习优化工具调用策略。在 CityRefer 上，该方法取得最佳 Hit@1 和 IoU，且明显快于最强排序基线；它无需真实框候选，并在 STPLS3D-Refer 零样本测试中展现更强跨场景鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.
